result.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
result.summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we reveal that quantization sensitivity is both taskand time-dependent, with different downstream tasks exhibiting distinct precision requirements across denoising steps. We further show that these patterns can be predicted without groundtruth labels or task-specific evaluation metrics. Building on these findings, we introduce T 2Quant, a task and time-aware mixedprecision quantization framework that uses a label-free sensitivity signal to optimally allocate activation precision across denoising steps under a fixed bit-width budget. Extensive experiments across three DLMs and six benchmarks demonstrate that T 2Quant consistently improves the average accuracy of existing quantization methods, achieving gains of up to 6.7 percentage points under the same budget.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出扩散语言模型的量化敏感度随下游任务和去噪步变化，并提出 T2Quant：用无标签的敏感度信号，在固定比特预算下为不同去噪步分配激活精度。
